parameters.query:
INSERT INTO loan_products (product_name, bank_name, interest_rate, min_income, min_credit_score, employment_types, source_url)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.product_name }}',
  '{{ $json.bank_name }}',
  {{ $json.interest_rate }},
  {{ $json.min_income }},
  {{ $json.min_credit_score }},
  '{{ $json.employment_types }}',
  '{{ $json.source_url }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (bank_name, product_name) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  interest_rate = EXCLUDED.interest_rate,
  min_income = EXCLUDED.min_income,
  min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
  last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
